recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Saint-Martin (French part). Parliamentary democracy (territorial council); overseas collectivity of france.
rulers: President Emmanuel MACRON (since 14 May 2017); represented by Prefect Cyrille LE VELY (since 10 February 2025); President of Territorial Council Louis MUSSINGTON (since 3 April 2022)
government: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Council); overseas collectivity of France
economy: high-income French Caribbean territorial economy; extremely reliant on tourism, with severe COVID-19 impacts; near-total destruction from Hurricane Irma in 2017; some offshore banking; import-dependent; duty-free commerce; yachting destination
military: no regular military forces; Ministry of Justice: Police Force of Sint Maaten (Korps Politie Sint Marteen, KPSM) (2025)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
